page.overview:
Who is Omnipotus?

Omnipotus is a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 2 to 5.

Though his origins and full abilities remain mysterious, Omnipotus serves as a dangerous threat both to the Guardians of the Globe and to Invincible himself.

Omnipotus is an alien warlord with a terrifying and monstrous presence. Towering at well over 12 feet tall, far above average humanoids, his massive frame is both bulky and powerfully muscular. His exposed skull-like face resembles that of a decayed or undead creature, featuring sharp, jagged green teeth and hollow eye sockets. A dark, spiked helmet with jagged points crowns his head, amplifying his menacing visage. His jaw appears mechanical or bone-like, adding to his eerie aura.

His pale purple skin contrasts with the dark purple armor plating that covers his torso and legs. The armor is angular and adorned with spikes and intricate, tech-inspired designs. His broad shoulders and forearms are armored and spiked, reinforcing his threatening look.
